pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(piano instrumental, reflective and soft atmosphere)

[Verse 1]
Your smile that melted deep inside
still shakes me quietly
now I move my steps to let go
returning once more to the familiar cafe

Familiar melodies and coffee scents
slowly soak into my dreaming heart
yet you remain tucked in the corners of me
I trace your fragrance carried by the wind

[Chorus]
Through nights I cried telling myself I’m okay
your warmth doesn’t fade
finally, I catch sight of your back
pinching myself, is this a dream again?

[Verse 2]
A stranger leaning on your shoulder
smiling beside you now
my soul shatters silently
unknown tears fall freely

I never forgot a single moment of you
you now hold a different sky
my tears never reach you
only echoing alone in empty air

[Piano Solo]
(expressive emotional piano solo)

[Bridge]
You walk a morning of another path
I know it’s time to let go
your marks return as bruises in my chest
but I won’t love the same way again

[Chorus]
The pain, the love once held
even the cold wind becomes gentle
I won’t be shaken again
I won’t cry anymore

[Outro]
Even the traces you left behind
become a light of my soul
embracing my wounds, lifting me up
where your traces fade
a new spirit rises
